name: 91709 · Chino Hills, CA
findings: ZIP 91709 (Chino Hills) has 219 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91709 (Chino Hills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91709 (Chino Hills) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
